context: A mom helps her young son plan an after-school activity
purpose: Teach: うっかり/おもい/おなか/つづく/とれる/はじめる/はたして/ましてや

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔、ただいま。今日のおやつ、エビせんべいだよ。おなかすいてるでしょ？
lines.en: Sho, I'm home. Today's snack is shrimp crackers. You're hungry, right?
lines.style: Warm motherly greeting with cheerful upward inflection and gentle pace

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、ペコペコ！ねえお母さん、ぼく何か習い事はじめるって決めたんだ。
lines.en: Yeah, starving! Hey Mom, I decided I'm going to start a lesson.
lines.style: Excited child voice bouncing with eager energy and bright pitch

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あら、いいわね。何にするの？ピアノ？それともドラム？
lines.en: Oh, that's nice. What will it be? Piano? Or drums?
lines.style: Curious encouraging tone with soft maternal smile in voice

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ドラム！かっこいいから！でも、はたしてぼくにできるかな…
lines.en: Drums! Because they're cool! But I wonder if I can really do it...
lines.style: Bold then suddenly doubtful, voice dipping into uncertainty

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 大丈夫よ。最初は誰でも難しい。ましてや初めての楽器ならね。
lines.en: It'll be fine. It's hard for anyone at first. Especially with a first instrument.
lines.style: Reassuring calm wisdom delivered slowly with steady warmth

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: でもスティック、おもいんだよ。前に持たせてもらったとき、うっかり落としちゃった。
lines.en: But the sticks are heavy. When I held them before, I accidentally dropped one.
lines.style: Sheepish admission with slight embarrassed laugh underneath

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、可愛い。練習がつづくうちに、すぐリズムもとれるようになるわよ。
lines.en: Hehe, cute. As your practice continues, you'll catch the rhythm soon enough.
lines.style: Affectionate chuckle followed by gently confident encouragement

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ほんと？じゃあ明日、教室見に行こうよ！おなかいっぱい食べてから行く！
lines.en: Really? Then let's go see the class tomorrow! I'll go after eating my fill!
lines.style: Voice surging with renewed excitement and childlike determination
